maf.inProgress: Game in progress — you're in the next one

boss.name: Mafia Boss
boss.desc: Leads the mafia vote. Checks if a player is the Detective.
boss.night: At night wake with the mafia, choose the victim, then ask the narrator if one player is the Detective.

mafia.name: Mafia
mafia.desc: Wakes with the boss and chooses a victim.
mafia.night: At night wake with the mafia and pick one player to kill together.

detective.name: Detective
detective.desc: Checks one player each night: mafia or not.
detective.night: At night point at one player — the narrator shows you if they're mafia.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.desc: Saves one player each night. Self once.
doctor.night: At night pick one player to save. If the mafia picked them, nobody dies. You can save yourself once.

maniac.name: Maniac
maniac.desc: Plays alone. Wins if last one standing.
maniac.night: At night wake alone and pick one player to kill.

lover.name: Lover
lover.night: At night pick one player — their night action doesn't work tonight.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Protects one player; dies in their place.
bodyguard.night: At night pick one player to guard. If they're attacked, you die instead.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: One shot per game, at night.
sniper.night: Once per game, at night, you can shoot one player. Choose wisely.

journalist.name: Journalist
journalist.desc: Compares two players: same team or not.
journalist.night: At night point at two players — the narrator shows if they're on the same team.

immortal.name: Immortal
immortal.desc: Can't be killed at night. Only the vote takes them out.
immortal.night: Night kills don't work on you. Only the town's vote can take you out.

civilian.name: Civilian
civilian.desc: No night action. Finds the mafia by talking.
civilian.night: You sleep at night. No night action.

town.name: TOWN
town.day: By day talk, find the mafia and vote them out. Keep your role quiet.
town.win: You win when every mafia member and the maniac are out.

mafia.name: MAFIA
mafia.day: By day blend in and steer the vote away from your team.
mafia.win: You win when the mafia equals or outnumbers everyone else.

solo.name: SOLO
solo.day: By day trust nobody and steer the vote to suit you.
solo.win: You win if you're the last one standing, or one of the last two.

maf.readyHint: Hold the card to look. Make sure nobody can see your screen.
maf.youreOut: You're out — %{fate}. Stay quiet, no hints!

croc.choosing: The host is choosing who shows
croc.rule: Show it, don't say it — no words, no sounds
